items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because Blue, the saxophone player, he was from St. Louis.

ctx.x: Wheeler was there. DePriest was there. Because DePriest was the only one I could get the story of the band, how they got organized. It was a funny thing, they had all guys from Missouri.
